implementation: Faithful read-only reproduction of engine/rust/question_selection.rs select; candidates sorted by entity ID, difficulty band weighted draw, then SHA256 second draw within band. learning.rs lines 598-622 excludes seen and invalid candidates before select.
limitations: No learner history or active policy snapshot supplied; exact production next-question probabilities are unavailable. Tested easy-only positive-weight pool and a no-repeat sequence using explicit stand-in new entity IDs.
Selection can remove or reorder items but cannot cure an item-local bank cue: all surviving easy records have it, regardless of future entity IDs, ordering or histories.
Original inventory source questions are captured originals, not generated records; no generated records found in captured bank.
